main.description: Generated meeting minutes (議事録) for a recorder session: summary + decisions + action items + topics, derived from transcriptSegment records. Generated either by the deterministic extractive generator (hermetic) or by Murakumo LLM (G4 Murakumo-only, ADR-2605215000). The whole body is sealed in the kotoba E2E envelope (ADR-2605181100); recipients = onBehalfOfDid + explicitly granted DIDs. The substrate never sees plaintext.

decisions.description: Decisions / agreements reached in the meeting, one per entry.

topics.description: Keyword topics extracted from the transcript.

participantHashes.description: Distinct speakerHash values observed in the source segments (sha256, not reversible).

generator.description: extractive = deterministic hermetic generator; murakumo = Murakumo LLM via LiteLLM loopback (operator-gated, G4 Murakumo-only).

ownerHash.description: speakerHash of the participant the item is attributed to (sha256, not reversible).

dueDate.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when one was stated in the meeting.
